text:
MIN 655 Amendment 2 (M+F) new-style certificates for UK seafarers and those working onboard UK ships
Information on the format of new electronic and existing physical certificates issued by the Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) to UK seafarers.
Documents
Details
This Marine Information Note (MIN) replaces the previous version of MIN 655. Amendment 2 includes the updated format for the Electronic UK FSE, BML and MEOL.
This MIN provides information on the format of the following certificates issued by the MCA:
- Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Certificates of Competency (CoC)
- GMDSS certificates
- Flag State Endorsement and Certificates of Equivalent Competency (FSE/CEC)
- Boatmasters’ Licence (BML)
- Marine Engine Operators Licence (MEOL)
This MIN covers:
- introduction and background to the certificates
- the format of the new electronic certificates
- the current application process that seafarers should follow to obtain and revalidate certification from the MCA, including: 
  - applying for a UK CoC requiring the submission of a training record book
  - the application process for those applying for a UK CoC
  - the application process for those applying for a UK FSE/CEC
Annexes A, B, C and D contain samples of existing physical and new electronic certificate formats.
This notice should be read with MIN 690: Guidance on the MCA Oral Examination Booking, the Issue of Notices of Eligibility (NOEs) and the Online Oral Examination Processes - Amendment 6.
Notice to:
- shipowners
- owners
- masters
- officers
- cadets
- those concerned with maritime training
This MIN expires 12 November 2027.
